# Search Visibility Checker

> A free tool from RVA Digital Works that scans any website for SEO and AI
> searchability, then returns a scored report card with prioritised fixes.
> No signup, no cost.

## What it does

Enter a URL and the checker fetches the page the way a crawler sees it on first
load - static HTML, before JavaScript runs - and scores it on:

- Core SEO: title, meta description, headings, canonical, image alt text
- Structured data: Schema.org JSON-LD presence and types
- AI searchability: llms.txt, robots.txt, and whether AI crawlers are allowed
- Competitor comparison against similar sites
- An exportable branded PDF report

## Pages

- [Checker](https://tools.rvadigitalworks.com/): paste a URL, get a scored report
- [What we check and why](https://tools.rvadigitalworks.com/checks): every check
  explained - what it means, why it matters for AI search, how to fix it, and
  how often Richmond businesses miss it

## Who it is for

Small business owners and marketers who want to know whether search engines and
AI assistants can actually read and cite their website.
